welcome.title: Welcome to LabTrack MN
welcome.body: Scan the activation QR code from your admin to activate your account. If you have activated it before, sign in.

activate.title: Activate account
activate.scanHint: Point the camera at the QR code on the admin's screen.
activate.scanInvalid: This QR code is not a LabTrack MN activation code. Scan the code your admin gave you.
activate.cameraNeeded: Camera access is needed to scan the QR code.
activate.codeReady: Activation code read. Now set your own password. Your admin does not know it.
activate.rules: At least 10 characters. Pick a hard-to-guess password made of several words. It is best not to include your name.
activate.done: Your account is active. Sign in with your username and new password.
activate.noCamera: If you cannot use the camera, ask your admin to send the activation link by SMS and open it on this phone.
activate.usernameHint: Enter the username printed on your sign-in card.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: For your security, only an admin can reset a password. The admin calls you back on your registered phone, confirms who you are, and gives you a code to set a new password.
forgot.never: An admin never asks for or knows your password.

adminReset.title: An admin reset your password
adminReset.body: An admin issued a code to set a new password for your account, so this device was signed out.
adminReset.ifNotYou: If you did not ask for this, call {phone} right away.
adminReset.ifNotYouNoPhone: If you did not ask for this, contact your organisation's admin right away.
adminReset.login: Sign in with the new password

consent.title: Consents
consent.intro: Before using LabTrack MN, read and accept the terms below. You can review and withdraw your consents later in Settings.
consent.updated: The terms have changed. Please read and accept them again.
consent.needAll: To continue, give the three required consents.
consent.declined: Without these consents LabTrack MN cannot store your health information, so the app cannot be used. You can come back and agree later.
consent.outdated: The terms were just updated. Read the new version and accept again.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.summary: LabTrack MN is a tool to organise and keep your test results, medicines and treatments. It gives no diagnosis or treatment advice — ask your doctor about health questions.
terms.body: The app is for organising, storing and reviewing information, reminders you set up, and sharing with people you choose. It does not suggest medicine doses, check drug interactions or interpret results. Only your organisation's admin creates accounts; you set your own password and the admin never knows it. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: Explains who is responsible for your data, where it is kept, who it is shared with and for how long.
privacy.body: The data controller is the company that provides the app. Data is kept on servers in Mongolia and sent over encrypted connections. Admins cannot see your health information — only in a documented emergency approved by two admins, which then shows in the admin history in the app. Data is passed only to people you allow (doctor, caregiver) and to contracted providers needed to run the service (hosting, SMS, notifications; and the AI service if you allow AI). You have the right to see, correct and delete your data. After you ask to delete your account, data is erased for good after 30 days; backup copies expire within a limited time. Copies you have already shared yourself (PDFs, etc.) cannot be recalled by us.

sensitive_data.title: Processing health information
sensitive_data.summary: Test results, medicines and transplant details are sensitive data under the law, so separate consent is needed.
sensitive_data.body: Under the Law on Personal Data Protection, health information is sensitive data. You agree that the results, medicines, treatments and transplant details you enter are processed only for this app's service (storing, organising, charts, reminders, sharing). If you withdraw this consent, the app can no longer be used; what you entered stays stored and you can have your account deleted.

ai.title: Read results with AI
ai.summary: Photos and PDFs of your results are sent to an AI service in the USA (Anthropic Claude) to read the values automatically. Without this, you enter values by hand.
ai.body: This consent has two parts: (1) processing documents with AI, and (2) transferring data outside Mongolia (to the USA). Values read by the AI are stored as a draft; they appear in charts and summaries only after you check and confirm them (a value that may need urgent attention is flagged before that). How long the provider keeps sent documents is set out in the privacy policy. You can withdraw at any time; from then on no document is sent abroad, but documents already sent cannot be recalled.

consent.appOutdated: The terms have a new version, so please update the app. After updating, read the new text and accept it.

biometric.title: Open the app quickly and safely
biometric.body: Unlock with biometrics (fingerprint or face) when you open the app and after {minutes} minutes away? Your biometric data stays on the phone and is never sent to us.
biometric.failed: Could not confirm. Try again or choose "Not now".
biometric.later: You can turn this on later in Settings.

lock.title: LabTrack MN is locked
lock.body: To protect your health information, unlock with your phone's fingerprint or face. The phone PIN does not work here.
lock.failed: Could not unlock. Try again, or sign out and sign in again with your password.
lock.changed: The phone's biometric settings changed (a finger or face was added or removed), so for your security sign in again with your password.
lock.usePassword: Sign out and sign in with password

status.title: System status
status.unreachable: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

admin.address_required: Your address could not be determined. Reload the page.
admin.already_activated: This account is already activated. If the password is forgotten, issue a reset token.
admin.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
admin.identity_already_set: This user's national ID is already enrolled.
admin.identity_check_limit: Today's identity check limit is reached. Another admin can check, or try again tomorrow.
admin.identity_check_required: Run a successful identity check first (valid for 10 minutes).
admin.identity_in_person: No national ID is enrolled. Identify the person in person with their ID card and enrol it.

admin.import_invalid: The file has invalid rows. Fix them and upload again. No account was created.

admin.invalid_phone: The phone number is invalid. Enter an 8-digit Mongolian number.
admin.lockout_clear_limit: This user's lockout was cleared too many times today.
admin.no_pending_deletion: This account has no pending deletion, or 30 days have passed.
admin.no_phone: This user has no registered phone. Use the in-person QR.

admin.reset_needs_other_admin: You enrolled this user's national ID, so another admin must do the reset.
admin.reset_required: The account was locked for security reasons. It reopens only after an identity check and a password reset.
admin.session_invalid: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

auth.admin_reset: An admin reset your account password, so this device was signed out.
auth.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
auth.locked: Too many failed attempts. Wait a while and try again.
auth.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
auth.session_invalid: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

consent.not_allowed: You cannot give consent for this profile.
consent.required: Give the required consents to continue.
consent.version_outdated: The consent text was updated. Read the new text and consent again.

error.internal: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact the system administrator.

me.no_recent_admin_action: No admin action on your account in the last 30 days.

password.contains_username: Don't include your username in the password.
password.too_long: The password is too long (up to 128 characters).
password.too_short: The password needs at least 10 characters.
password.too_weak: The password is too easy to guess. Use a longer phrase of several words.

problem.columns: Wrong columns (username, display_name; optionally phone, role).
problem.display_name: Display name is empty, too long or contains forbidden characters.
problem.encoding: The file is not UTF-8. Save it from Excel as "CSV UTF-8".
problem.too_large: The file is too large (up to 1 MB).

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.expired: Your session ended (15 min idle or 8 hours). Sign in again.
login.invalid: Wrong username, password or authenticator code.

new.title: Register a user
new.hint: Register only after identifying the person (in person or by video call). No password is set — the user activates the account.
new.national_id: National ID (from the ID card, e.g. УБ90010101; optional)

detail.deletion: The user asked to delete the account. It is erased on {date}.

activation.title: Activation
activation.hint: The user scans this QR with the phone that has the app and sets their own password. Valid 15 minutes, shown once.
activation.sms: Send SMS to the registered phone

qr.expired: The QR expired. Create a new one.
qr.notice_not_sent: No notice reached the user's registered phone. Tell them another way.
qr.once: The QR is shown only once — after hiding it you cannot see it again.
qr.hidden: The QR is hidden. Create a new one if needed (the old one stops working).

card.title: LabTrack MN — login card
card.note: This card holds no password. Never tell anyone your password.

identity.hint: First call the registered phone BACK, then ask the person for their national ID. The system only says whether it matches.
identity.match: It matches. You may reset within 10 minutes.
identity.no_match: It does not match. Do not reset unless the person is verified.
identity.enrol_title: Enrol national ID (in person, from the ID card)
identity.match_expired: The identity check's 10 minutes are over. Check again.

reset.title: Password reset
reset.hint: The old password stops working at once and every device is signed out. The user sets a new password.
reset.needs_check: Run a successful identity check above first.
reset.confirm: You are about to reset {name}'s password. The old password stops working and every device is signed out.

status_change.title: Change status
status_change.confirm: You are about to set {name} to "{status}". Every device is signed out.

unlock.title: Clear login lockout
unlock.hint: Clears the temporary lockout from failed logins (the account status is unchanged).

phone.title: Reveal phone number
phone.confirm: This is recorded in the audit log (up to 20 a day). Use it only to call back.

deletion.cancel_hint: Only at the user's request. The account comes back locked and needs an identity check and a password reset.
deletion.cancelled: Deletion cancelled. The account is locked.
deletion.confirm: You are about to cancel {name}'s deletion. Only at the user's request.

import.title: Bulk registration from CSV
import.hint: Columns: username, display_name, phone (optional), role (user/doctor). The file is never stored, only checked in memory. National IDs are enrolled in person later.
import.confirm: You are about to register {count} users. This cannot be undone.
import.stale: The file changed. Preview it again.
import.caption: Rows ready to register
